Every paper on Conjura is listed here. New ones are added to this page rather
than sitting directly under [Papers](/projects/index.qmd), which holds the
policy and process pages instead.

Each carries a [status badge](/problems/status-legend/index.qmd) graded on
the same scale as a conjecture's: what has been checked, by whom, and how, and
never more than that. A paper being here says it exists and is addressable, not
that it is finished.

## Papers

- [**The Uber Assumption and its Random Self-Reducibility**](/projects/uber-groups-rsr/index.qmd)
  <br>*in Non-Bilinear and Type 1, 2, 3 Bilinear Groups.* Working draft. Defines
  the Uber assumption uniformly across the four group settings, gives one
  affine reparametrization theorem covering all of them, shows no monomial
  target can separate two settings, and exhibits a non-monomial target that
  separates Type 2 from Type 3. The mathematics is still under revision and
  nobody has reviewed it.
